timeline.author: Andrei Dan

timeline.body:
@HiDAl I'm not sure why this test was reading the result from the health node. That's not a requirement. The shard capacity indicator does not use any information from the health node (but reads the limits from the cluster state of the node that handles the `_health_report` request)

I've changed the test to reflect this by reading the result from a random node. Happy to make this change in a separate PR if you think it might be problematic or if it doesn't make sense?

reply.body: I think you're right... I copied part of this test from the DiskHealthIndicator, so probably it's a bad copy-paste
